$comment: Shared sample-screen manifest for the voice family (shots tool, voice dictation / read aloud / voice conversation). One source for page names and per-page demo states across the iOS and Android debug shot entries (iOS is the gold reference; Web has no voice UI). Every end seeds in-memory state only: never opens the microphone, never plays audio, never touches the network, never writes a real store. The voice catalog is decoded from catalog (a repo path) through the production catalog decoder instead of being fetched; connections listed in connections are seeded in memory with placeholder keys so engine rows have candidates. surface: readAloud = chat page with the conversation below, read-aloud control on the last assistant message; dictation = chat page composer with the dictation state; settings = Settings > Voice; engineSheet = the dictation engine picker sheet opened from Settings > Voice; composer = chat page with an empty draft (primary button shows the voice-conversation waveform); home = home page with an empty hero draft; voiceBar = chat page with the voice conversation bar in place of the composer.

conversation.text: Give me three tips for a calmer morning.

1. Lay out tomorrow's clothes tonight.
2. Keep your phone out of reach for the first twenty minutes.
3. Drink a glass of water before coffee.

$dictationLevels: Static level meter for the recording page (0...1, oldest to newest); both ends draw exactly these bars.
$stageClock: Animation clock for every voiceBar page, in ms: both ends render the stage (fog drift sin(t/2600), orb flow, listening breathe) as if this much time had passed since the stage appeared, and freeze there. 0 = drift 0, the canvas default.
$disclosure: disclosure on a composer page = the provider kind whose realtime model was just picked in the chat model picker for the first time: the chat page shows the realtime cloud disclosure for that provider's catalog realtime[] isDefault model (copy voice_realtime_disclosure_title / _body), consent not written (E-604).
$pages: name is the shared page id (iOS VoiceShots.Shot / Android voice shot page); the other keys are the demo state for that page. level on a voiceBar page is the one stage level (user level on caption, assistant level on speaking); pages without it use level 0.
